values.AssociatedLNGNotes: The Saguaro Connector carries Permian gas to the Mexican border to feed the Saguaro Energia LNG export plant in Sonora. A trade press report on the 2024 Federal Energy Regulatory Commission approval says the gas is for overseas LNG shipment.

verifications.note: Article on FERC approval of Saguaro Connector says gas goes into Mexico for overseas LNG shipment via Saguaro Energia

records.researcher_notes: The sheet already said yes and Saguaro Energia LNG Terminal. The trade press report confirms it. ONEOK said it would wait for the LNG plant's final investment decision.

values.AssociatedLNGNotes: This short border crossing lateral links the Saguaro Connector to the Sierra Madre pipeline in Mexico that serves the Saguaro Energia LNG export plant. A trade press report on the 2024 Federal Energy Regulatory Commission approval of the border facilities ties them to LNG shipment.

verifications.note: Article on FERC approval of Saguaro border facilities says gas goes into Mexico for overseas LNG shipment

records.researcher_notes: The article covers the whole Saguaro project, including the border crossing, so the tie to this lateral runs through the project.
